body:
Workrave 1.11.5 adds quiet micro-breaks, Windows power options during breaks,
and GNOME Shell 51 support. It also improves tray menus and window visibility,
and fixes problems with reading-mode timers, language selection, and sound preferences.


- New features and improvements:
  - Added a "Break in quiet-mode" option for micro-breaks, so their timer can keep
    running without automatic break reminders while rest-break reminders remain enabled
    (#743, Pedro Rolo)
  - Added support for GNOME Shell 51
  - Added an option to hide the status window from the taskbar and window switcher
    on Windows and Linux/X11. This option is enabled by default (#701, #747)
  - Added shutdown, sleep, and hibernate options to the rest-break window on Windows (#735)
  - The Windows installer now supports `/NOLAUNCH` to skip starting Workrave after installation
- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed reading-mode timers staying paused after leaving suspended mode (#724, #727, #739)
  - Fixed empty tray menus on Linux, including when using i3 with Polybar (#750)
  - Fixed the GNOME Shell menu not appearing after choosing "Open Workrave" (#750)
  - Fixed switches in the GNOME Shell menu not applying changes when dragged
  - Fixed Workrave ignoring the system language when no language was selected in preferences
  - Fixed crashes in Linux panel applets when Workrave's settings could not be found
  - The Linux indicator applet now respects the automatic-start setting
  - Fixed registry permission errors when installing Workrave for the current Windows user (#749)
  - Fixed blocking break windows appearing in the taskbar and window switcher on
    Windows and Linux/X11 (#747)
  - Fixed the preferences window opening when dismissing the Windows tray menu (#720)
  - The Windows tray menu now follows the selected light or dark appearance (#715)
  - Fixed the selected sound theme being shown incorrectly when reopening sound preferences (#702)

Workrave 1.11.4 fixes a crash in version 1.11.2 with the new audio device selection support on Linux.


- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed a crash when selecting an audio device on Linux.

Workrave 1.11.2 has been released. You can now choose which speakers or headphones play your break reminders. This release also  fixes several problems that could cause Workrave to crash or lose saved timer progress and statistics.

- New features and improvements:
  - You can now choose which speakers or headphones Workrave uses in the sound
    preferences on Windows, Linux, and macOS. For example, you can play break
    reminders through your speakers while other sounds use your headphones (#700, koloved)
  - Improved error reports to help us investigate problems
- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed incorrect break timer settings when using Workrave for the first time
  - Workrave now uses the default timer settings if saved settings are missing or damaged
  - Fixed a problem that could prevent Workrave from starting on Windows if saved
    settings were damaged
  - Fixed problems starting Workrave when exercise files were missing or damaged
  - Fixed crashes when Workrave could not save timer progress or statistics, or delete
    statistics history, for example because another program was using the files
  - Workrave now keeps the previously saved timer progress and statistics if saving
    new data fails
  - Fixed a crash that could occur when a break reminder appeared on Windows
  - Restored missing icons in the tray and timer-window menus on Windows (#736)

Workrave 1.11.1 fixes several Windows installation issues. This release contains no functional changes to Workrave itself; all changes are limited to the Windows installer.


- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed missing Microsoft Visual C++ runtime dependency on Windows, which could cause
    Workrave to fail to start with a "VCRUNTIME140.dll was not found" error
  - Fixed an issue where the installer would repeatedly claim Workrave was still running
    and refuse to continue, even when it wasn't
  - Fixed the installed version number not being shown for Workrave in the Windows
    "Apps & Features" list
  - Fixed an issue where the installer did not uninstall Workrave 1.10 when upgrading,
    leaving both versions installed side by side

Workrave 1.11.0 has been released. This is the first stable release of the 1.11 series,
the result of more than four years of alpha, beta, and release candidate development.

Changes since Workrave 1.10.54
- Highlights:
  - You can now change the operation mode for a limited amount of time (#98, #305)
  - Workrave can automatically change the operation mode based on Windows Focus Assist (#255, #226)
  - High DPI support on both Windows (#650, Charlie Lin) and Xorg
  - Several new sounds contributed by Phil Dibbs
  - The Windows version is now 64 bit, with a modern Windows 11 UI theme
  - Modern desktop integration on Linux: StatusNotifierItem tray icons and a redesigned
    GNOME Shell extension supporting GNOME Shell 50, Wayland (experimental), and high-DPI/fractional scaling
  - An auto-update feature for Windows
  - ARM64 Windows support, including keyboard/mouse locking
  - The Workrave networking functionality was removed
  - The legacy Windows DeskBand/taskbar applet was removed
- New features and improvements:
  - Workrave now follows the XDG Base Directory specification (#192)
  - A dark UI theme on Windows now follows the OS dark/light mode setting (#214, #529)
  - The default sound theme was changed to the "Subtle" theme (#362)
  - It is no longer required to accept the GPL license on installation on Windows (#648)
  - The Windows installer now asks whether to install Workrave per-user or system-wide
  - The D-Bus utility (gdbus) is no longer installed by default by the installer
  - Added examples of usage with swaybar (#597, J. J. Ramsey)
  - Ported the Workrave Python scripts for waybar, Yambar, etc. to dasbus (#557-#563, #627, J. J. Ramsey)
  - Allow Workrave to ignore idle inhibitors if possible (#596, J. J. Ramsey)
  - A portable version is now available for Windows and Linux
- Desktop integration:
  - Support for the StatusNotifierItem protocol (#447)
  - The redesigned GNOME Shell extension supports GNOME Shell 50 and fixes several extension
    issues beyond the support already available in Workrave 1.10 (#396, #582, #661)
  - Added DPI scaling support for the GNOME Shell extension on Xorg, and fixed Wayland detection
  - Use the GNOME Shell extension to display prelude windows (#621)
  - Added Cinnamon applet support with GTK 4 (#487)
  - Fixed Wayland activity monitoring on KDE, and improved layer-shell support on other Wayland compositors
  - Handle the screen lock shortcut during breaks under Xorg
  - Enable application autostart across all Linux desktop managers (#548, Jon Petrissans)
- Notable bug fixes (spanning the full 1.11 development cycle):
  - Fixed crash when a monitor is powered off (#606)
  - Fixed an empty AppIndicator menu (#556, #614, wojnilowicz)
  - Fixed the tray icon not appearing on waybar, swaybar, or wf-shell (#555, #613, wojnilowicz)
  - Fixed the status window showing when Sway reloads despite being disabled (#612, #615, wojnilowicz)
  - Fixed the Rest Break window appearing in the top left corner in "No Lock" mode (#663, #664, ValdikSS)
  - Fixed a crash on wlroots compositors when a break starts (#550, #552, #553, #554, Kirill Primak)
  - Fixed high DPI fractional scaling on Windows
  - Fixed the application icon on Linux
  - Fixed DPI scaling with multiple monitors (#308, #315)
  - Prevented state and daily-statistics data loss by saving files atomically
  - Fixed focus changing unexpectedly after a break warning
  - Fixed the main window reopening after the screen was unlocked
  - Fixed the Rest Break window opening below other Workrave windows
  - Fixed exercises not always appearing on the primary monitor
  - Fixed issues that prevented sounds or the status window from being disabled (#443, #444)
  - Fixed Windows language selection, special characters in the tray menu, and unselectable menu items
  - Improved hibernate/suspend handling (#539, #540)
- Translations:
  - Added Georgian translation (#669, NorwayFun)
  - Created and maintained the Tamil translation (#498, #579, #581, TamilNeram)
  - Simplified Chinese: complete overhaul (#385, #391, sr093906) and further updates (#645, Sisyphe42)
  - Updated Indonesian translation (#560, #653, Andika Triwidada)
  - Updated Italian translation (#359, #403, #489, #490, #496, albanobattistella)
  - Updated Polish translation (#423, #465, #484, ChuckMichael, Hanna Kraska)
  - Updated French translation (#545, WedoneOfficiel; fix #656)
  - Updated Brazilian Portuguese translation (#512, Paulo Haddad Martim)
  - Updated Dutch translation (#437, WKobes) and fixed several strings
  - Updated Hebrew translation (#361, Omer I.S.)
  - Updated Persian translation (#358, MSKF)
  - Updated Catalan translation (#338, Jordi Mallach)
  - Updated Spanish translation (#494, Cristian Martínez)

body:

- Improvements:
  - Allow Workrave to ignore idle inhibitors if possible (#596, J. J. Ramsey)
  - Add examples of usage with swaybar (#597, J. J. Ramsey)
  - Support GNOME Shell 48
  - Update DBus example (#611, Emmanuel Ferdman)
  - Support for user defined colors (#619)
  - Port workrave Python scripts for waybar, etc., to dasbus (#627, J. J. Ramsey)
  - Phil Dibbs contributed new sounds (bells_ensemble, shangri_la, synth_harp, tinkle_bell, tuned_udu, woodwind_ensemble)
  - Support GNOME Shell 49 (#636, Alessandro Astone)
  - Keyboard/mouse locking now works on ARM64 Windows
  - Handle screen lock shortcut during breaks under Xorg
  - Add high DPI support on Windows (#650, Charlie Lin)
  - Use Gnome Shell extension to display prelude windows (#621)
  - It is no longer required to accept the GPL license on installation on Windows (#648)
- Bug fixes:
  - Fix crash when monitor is powered off (#606)
  - Fix an empty AppIndicator menu (#556, #614, wojnilowicz)
  - Fix issue where the tray icon did not appear on waybar, swaybar, or wf-shell trays (#555, #613, wojnilowicz)
  - Fix issue where the status window shows when Sway reloads despite being disabled (#612, #615, wojnilowicz)
  - Update AppIndicator menu when menu content changes (#556, #652,ValdikSS)
- Updated Translations:
  - Update Chinese translation (#645, Sisyphe42)
  - Updated Indonesian translation (#653, Andika Triwidada)
  - Fix French translation (#656)

name: 1.11.0-beta.11
body:

name: 1.11.0-beta.10
body:
Workrave 1.11.0-beta.10 has been released.

- Fix issue where after installing an update, some files got removed after the first reboot.
- Fix issue where the main window is reopened after the screen is unlocked.
- Fix issue where the rest break window is opened below other Workrave windows.
- Add activity monitoring for KDE on Wayland
- Improved Wayland support on KDE (and other Wayland compositors that support the Layer Shell protocol)

body:

name: Release v1.10.50
body:
Workrave 1.10.50 has been released. This release brings a number of small improvements.


- The "Restbreak now" button in the main window no longer responds to keyboard (#368)
- Allow installation on Windows without administrator rights.
- Fix vertical alignment of GNOME shell applet (#356)
- Support GNOME Shell 42 (#396)
- Restore support for Windows Vista and up (#367)
- The 'Backward shoulder stretch' exercises now plays a sound twice matching the description (#354)

name: Release v1.11.0.alpha1
body:
Changes since Workrave 1.10.49:

- Major internal code cleanup and code modernization.
- Initial (incomplete) port to macOS using Qt6
- The default sound theme was changed to the "Subtle" theme (#362)
- You can now change the operation mode for a limited amount of time (#98,
- A portable version is now available for Windows and Linux (#180)
- Workrave now follows the XDG basedirectory specification (#192)
- The Windows version is now 64 bit (#295)
- Workrave can now automatically change the operation mode based on Windows Focus Assist (#255,
- A dark UI theme is now supported on Windows (#214)
- Bug fixes:
  - Fixed Windows system tray menu that would not always properly open (#373)
  - Fixed vertical positioning of GNOME shell applet (#356)
  - GNOME shell applet is now compatible with GNOME up to version 42 (#342, #352, #355)
  - DPI scaling with multiple monitor has been fixed (#308, #315)
  - Fixed the description of the backward shoulder stretch exercise (#354)
  - Add version number to installer to support Microsoft's Windows Package Manager (winget) (#349, #353 by Kaleb Luedtke)
- Translations:
  - Complete overhaul of Simplified Chinese translation (#385 by sr093906)
  - Updated Hebrew translation (#361 by Omer I.S.)
  - Updated Italian translation (#359 by albanobattistella)
  - Updated Persian translation (#358 by MSKF)
  - Updated Catalan translation (#338 by Jordi Mallach)
- and more... (the final 1.11 release will have a more complete list of changes)

body:
